description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipDao class, which provides database access methods for EmployeeMembership entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes CRUD operations, search, and pagination functionality specific to employee memberships.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeMembership entities, providing methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee memberships within the database.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership entity by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeMembershipIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing employee membership IDs for a given employee number and list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes specified employee memberships by IDs for a given employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Performs a search for employee memberships based on filter parameters and returns matching records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipPaginator
methods.description: Prepares a paginator for employee membership search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee memberships matching the search filter parameters.
